summary: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE (not produced by IBM Bob). Checkout returns HTTP 500 for customers who signed in with SSO: the session is created without a customer profile, the gateway's lazy hydration never runs because it checks for undefined while the store initialises null, and PaymentService dereferences the null billing profile.

rootCause.title: Customer profile is never initialised after SSO authentication
rootCause.explanation: SYNTHETIC. loginWithSso creates a session but, unlike loginWithPassword, does not load the customer profile. The gateway middleware is meant to hydrate it lazily, but it only does so when session.customer === undefined, while SessionStore.create initialises customer to null. CustomerService.getBillingProfile therefore returns null for SSO sessions and PaymentService.charge reads defaultCardToken from null.
